audience: Owners and operations leaders of established Sydney residential building, renovation and field service businesses
problem: Accepted quotes, customer messages and job schedules are handed to the delivery team in separate places, so paid crew time is spent finding missing or conflicting details before work can start.
single_message: Create one controlled job handover from approved sources, automate the gathering and routing, and keep commercial, safety and customer decisions behind a named human gate.
supporting_points: Build the handover from the accepted quote, customer messages and job schedule
Define a ready-to-start gate and route missing or conflicting details to a named owner
Keep scope, price, safety, scheduling exceptions and customer commitments under human judgement
desired_action: Bring one recent handover to a $0 on-site workflow review
